ravi (Finance): Quick announce: starting Aug 1, 2026 were simplifying hosted overage rules and adding clearer invoice granularity. Short summary: 1) flat overage bands (small/medium/large) to reduce surprise bills, 2) visible per-account burst meter in Console + API, 3) invoices broken out by model+region+token-type, 4) trial credit reduced for new signups. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/2026-overage-clarity :mega:

jun (Eng): What do you mean by "flat overage bands"?

ravi (Finance): Instead of per-token micro-charges that vary by minute, charges will fall into three predictable bands with clear per-10k token unit prices. Bands are sized to match typical workloads; you can see estimates in the console.

lucy (Legal): Any contract impacts?

ravi (Finance): No change to existing enterprise or Dedicated contracts. This affects hosted self-serve accounts only; enterprise customers can opt into the new model if desired.

billing-bot: SAMPLE INVOICE: https://billing.redwood.internal/samples/band-invoice-2026.pdf (shows banded pricing and model/region lines).

kate (Customer Success): Trial credit? many onboarding flows rely on it.

ravi (Finance): Trial credit goes from 50k -> 20k tokens for new signups after Aug 1. Existing trial accounts created before Aug 1 will be grandfathered for 30 days. We'll send targeted emails and show a console banner.

billy (Growth): Are partner promo credits affected?

ravi (Finance): Partner and promo credits are unchanged. Only the default self-serve trial amount is reduced.

jun (Eng): Will this cause more 429s / throttles?

ravi (Finance): We designed a queue-first behavior for the first 10 days after rollout; requests are queued before billing catches up. Post-grace, soft throttles apply when burst meter is empty. SDKs will get a small patch with recommended retry/backoff.

lucy (Legal): Refund policy for rollout-caused disruptions?

ravi (Finance): Auto-credits for sustained service degradation (criteria: >= 30 mins continuous degraded requests) and a fast-track dispute route for CS.

kate (Customer Success): Action items for CS: email templates, KB update, migration CSV. I'll own the rollout comms.

jun (Eng): How can we simulate exhaustion in staging?

ravi (Finance): Use header X-Redwood-Billing-Test: exhaustion to force burst-empty behavior in staging.

ravi (Finance): Timeline: opt-in beta July 5, general rollout Aug 1, 10-day grace where we queue. Questions -> #billing-questions or finance@redwood.com. Exec signoff: Ravinder (CFO). :white_check_mark:
